summary.result: Accordingly, waste activated carbon can be used for porous concrete material.
summary.background: The void ratio was decreased and ultrasonic pulse velocity was increased with increasing the waste activated carbon powder, respectively.
summary.method: The compressive strength and flexural strength of porous concrete using waste activated carbon powder were in the range of 8.21 ${\sim1}$ 6.58 MPa and 1.69 ${\sim1}$ 3.68 MPa, respectively.
